name: TeraTips
author: Walpurgis Labs

sections.description:
TeraTips is a lightweight and powerful tipping solution designed for community websites using Ultimate Member and TeraWallet.

It allows your users to send tips (donations) to other members directly from their profile page. The transaction is processed instantly via the TeraWallet balance system.

This plugin is perfect for communities, social networks, or marketplaces where users want to support creators, experts, or friends.

🌟 Key Features (Free)

  • Seamless Integration: Adds a “Send a Tip” button on Ultimate Member profiles.
  • TeraWallet Native: Uses the existing wallet balance (no extra payment gateway setup required).
  • Commission System: Admin can set a percentage commission on every tip (earn money from your community!).
  • Instant Transfer: Money is instantly debited from the sender and credited to the receiver.
  • Email Notifications: The receiver gets an email notification when they receive a tip.
  • History Log: Admin dashboard to view all tip transactions.
  • Secure: Built with WordPress nonces and capability checks.

🚀 Unlock More with TeraTips Pro

Go further with the Pro version to manage your community like a boss:

  • Role Restrictions: Decide exactly who can receive tips (e.g., allow only “Vendors” or “Creators” to receive money).
  • Google Sheets Sync: Automatically send every transaction to a Google Sheet for accounting.
  • CSV Export: Export your tipping history in one click.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the teratips folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure you have Ultimate Member and TeraWallet installed and active.
  4. Go to Settings > TeraTips to configure your commission rate and max tip amount.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, because TeraWallet is based on WooCommerce.

Can I take a fee on tips?

Yes! You can set a global commission percentage (e.g., 20%) in the settings. The user receives the amount minus your commission.

Where does the money go?

The money moves from the sender’s Wallet balance to the receiver’s Wallet balance. No real money is transferred until the user withdraws funds from TeraWallet.
